generatedFrom.note: Images are from the tagged build of sha (1824883286a); they predate the sidebar tonal step and the ChromeHover pressed fills. Source refs are path:line (Type.member) at sourceRefsSha; the symbol is the stable anchor when lines drift. Colors are formulas over the terminal theme (theme.formulas sources re-read at sourceRefsSha on 2026-10-12, cx-jdb.2); the resolved tables under themes.* are computed by tools/derive_theme_tokens.py, a line-for-line port of ThemeTokens.derive and AppTheme.derive (appearance.accent cases and the theme's own accentColor added 2026-10-12, cx-jdb.6).

conventions.units: pt = macOS points (1 CSS px at devicePixelRatio 1; screenshots are 2x). Times in seconds.
conventions.colorRefs: token:<name> is a ThemeTokens field. alpha(token:x, a) replaces alpha. mix(a, b, t) = a + (b-a)*t per sRGB channel (ThemeRGB.mixed). over(fill, surface) = source-over compositing.
conventions.density: Every metric has compact and comfortable values. Default density is compact (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/DesignSettings.swift:25 (DesignSettings.density)). appearance.density in cmux.json switches it.
conventions.pixelSnapping: Strip and pill offsets snap to device pixels: snap(v)=round(v*scale)/scale, snapDown(v)=floor(v*scale+0.0001)/scale (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/PaneChromeMetrics.swift:69-77 (PaneChromeMetrics.snap)). Hairlines are 1/scale pt (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextLayout/Geometry/PaneChromeGeometry.swift:62 (PaneChromeGeometry.hairlineWidth)).

corners.rule: Ports draw each surface with the corner shape the Swift code uses, pixel for pixel: the continuous path below where Swift sets cornerCurve .continuous (and for every Liquid Glass panel), circular arcs where Swift uses the CALayer default, NSBezierPath(roundedRect:) or CGPath(roundedRect:).

continuousPath.description: One corner of radius r: a straight edge ends extent*r from the corner, then three cubic Beziers. Points are (inset from the near vertical edge, inset from the near horizontal edge) in units of r, for the top-left corner; the other corners mirror it. Do not clamp r or the extents when extent*r exceeds half a side: the overlapping curves fill the same shape CoreAnimation draws.
continuousPath.accuracy: Fitted to CALayer cornerCurve .continuous renders on macOS 26 and checked at 2x with tools/continuous_corner_check.swift: at most 3 of 255 levels on any pixel for r 4 to 12 on the chrome sizes (tab pills, +, trailing and close buttons, omnibar 24/28 with r 8, palette 640x400 r 10 and 720x480 r 12, sidebar rows, a 40x12 capsule). A square with r = half its side (the 6 pt unread dot): at most 9 levels. The iOS 7 constants (1.52866483, 1.08849323, 0.86840689, 0.66993427, 0.06549600, 0.37754822, 0.16550930) miss by up to 44 levels; do not use them.
continuousPath.skia: SkPath moveTo/lineTo/cubicTo with these points, filled antialiased.

corners.continuousSurfaces: tab pills; tab close, new-tab (+) and trailing buttons; sidebar rows, the selection pill and gap, section items and tiles, icon buttons (ChromeHover fills); the unread count pill and dot; drag lift cards; tab group chips and bands; the omnibar, its page-info chip, suggestion card and rows; hover card thumbnails; every Liquid Glass panel (NSGlassEffectView) and OverlaySurfaceView fallback
corners.circularOnPurpose: pane clips, pane borders, focus, glow and attention rings, the inactive dim: the browser page mask is a circular-arc path from the same radius, so the pane must match it (CmuxNextLayout/Views/PaneHostView.swift:128-131 (PaneClipView))
corners.circularByDefault: palette rows, keycaps and actions-menu rows (NSBezierPath roundedRect), tab status dots, drop overlay frames. Ports draw these circular too.

conventions.noBlue: No accent hue. Selection, hover and focus are the theme foreground at low alpha. The one hue chrome uses is token:highlight (the theme's ANSI 4, usually blue), and only in agent pane composer controls: the Send fill, the pressed plan toggle (highlight at 16% with highlight text) and a switch's on state (Packages/Shared/CmuxTheme/Sources/CmuxTheme/ThemeTokens.swift:79 (ThemeTokens.highlight); webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/composerControls.css .acpmux-send, .acpmux-plan[aria-pressed=true], .acpmux-on .acpmux-switch). token:textSelection is the theme's selection-background, so it can be blue when the theme's is. Exception: group colors are user content and may be any of nine fixed hues, blue included (see groupColors).
conventions.rounding: 8-bit channels round half away from zero, as Swift's .rounded() does in ThemeRGB.description: 0.30*255 = 76.5 -> 77 (0x4D). Python round() (half to even) is wrong here. Composited values are ThemeRGB.composited; a window-server screenshot can differ by one 8-bit level (Apple System dark selectionFill: #353535 by the formula, #343434 on screen).
conventions.fractionalFontSizes: Render fractional point sizes exactly (caption and shortcut are 10.5 pt compact). Skia takes fractional sizes; never round to 10 or 11.
conventions.panePadding: Ports add the same pane padding as the app (layout.panePadding, else 2 compact / 4 comfortable) above the strip and around the content, so the tab pill sits 3/3 pt from the cell top and the content border at compact density (pillTop = snapDown((28 - 24 - 2)/2) = 1, gap above = 2 + 1, gap below = 28 - 1 - 24).
conventions.ciGating: A state with a reference image gates port CI (pixel diff). A state without one is report-only (token checks and coverage) until its image exists; then it gates. Regenerated images replace the old ones in the same change.

input.description: ThemeInput: background, foreground, ANSI palette 0-15, selection-background/foreground and cursor-color (only when the config names a color), background-opacity (0-1), background-blur (0 off, >0 radius, <0 macOS glass). Read from the Ghostty config; cmux appearance.theme overrides theme = after the config files. appearance.accent (ThemeAccent: neutral, theme, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan; default neutral) is a cmux setting, not a Ghostty key. accentColor is the theme's own accent: its appearance.themeEdits <theme>/accent edit, else the theme file's '# cmux-accent = #rrggbb' line (a comment to Ghostty); it wins over appearance.accent for that theme (ThemeInput.accentColor).

defaultTheme.value: light:Apple System Colors Light,dark:Apple System Colors

input.lightDark: isDark = luminance(background) < luminance(foreground) (Packages/Shared/CmuxTheme/Sources/CmuxTheme/ThemeTokens.swift:142 (ThemeTokens.derive)). The app light/dark appearance picks the light: or dark: half of the theme spec.

stripBackground.value: = windowBackground: every pane's tab strip is the window ground (appearance.tabBarBackground is retired); focus and selection fills give the hierarchy

sidebarStep.value: alpha(fg, 0.04): the sidebar's tonal step (the Home Chief sidebar fill and the workspace row placeholder bar draw it)

stripStep.value: alpha(black, dark ? 0.22 : 0.05): no strip paints it (tab strips have no tonal step since appearance.tabBarBackground retired); the sidebar's space marks soften toward it (ProfileBarView.markColor)

textPrimary.value: inks(fg, rows = [worst, bg]), worst = the lower-contrast for fg of over(pressedFill,bg) and over(selectionFill,bg) (pressedFill with the neutral accent). fg when it reaches 4.5:1 on both rows; otherwise two candidates, fg pushed toward white and toward black (the pole with more contrast on worst first) in 0.02 steps until 4.5:1 on both rows (or the pole), each with its own textSecondary and textTertiary; the candidate whose textPrimary and textSecondary keep the higher least contrast over rows wins, the score capped at 4.5 (a tie keeps the first). Grass takes white (black reaches only 3.73:1 on its bg), Hot Dog Stand the dark ink (white reaches 4.20:1 on its red). Every port replays schemas/theme/theme-ink-vectors.json

textSecondary.value: muted(textPrimary toward bg, up to 0.38, keeping 4.5:1 over inkWorst); steps of 0.01. inkWorst = the lowest-contrast for textPrimary (each inks candidate's, see textPrimary) of worst and bg, and with background-opacity < 1 also of tint, over(pressedFill,tint) and over(selectionFill,tint), tint = over(alpha(bg, background-opacity), dark ? white : black)

textTertiary.value: muted(textPrimary toward bg, up to 0.55, keeping 3:1 over inkWorst (see textSecondary))

textPlaceholder.source: AppKit NSColor.placeholderTextColor resolved to sRGB (macOS 27, standard contrast); used by the Chief composer placeholder

selectionFill.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.10 : 0.08); with appearance.accent: alpha(accent, dark ? 0.26 : 0.16)

secondarySelectionFill.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.07 : 0.055); with appearance.accent: alpha(accent, dark ? 0.18 : 0.11)

separator.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.08 : 0.07); clear when appearance.borders = none

paneBorder.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.07 : 0.09); clear when appearance.borders = none

focusRing.value: alpha(fg, 0.40); with appearance.accent: the opaque app accent. The pane ring replaces the alpha with focusRing.contrast (see components.panes.focusRing)

textSelection.value: terminalSelection if set, else mix(bg, fg, 0.22)

terminalSelection.value: selection-background when the config names one and textPrimary reaches 3:1 on over(selection-background, bg); else none (an inverse-video selection keeps the derived textSelection)

caret.value: readable(cursor-color, bg, 3.0) when the config names one, else textPrimary

highlight.value: readable(ANSI 4, bg, 3.0); with appearance.accent: the app accent

highlightText.value: bg or textPrimary (opaque), whichever contrasts more with highlight, if >= 4.5; else black or white

accent.value: textPrimary (no hue) with appearance.accent = neutral; else the app accent (AppTheme accent: the ANSI slot of the named color, the brighter-chroma of normal and bright; theme = magenta, else blue, else cyan, the first with OKLCH chroma >= 0.05; the theme's own accentColor, when set, replaces that starting color whatever appearance.accent says; fitted to 3:1 on every plain surface and 4.5:1 under onAccent). Selected and active marks: unread dots, the user's messages, Send in the agent pane. AppKit controls use Palette.accent = focusRing.

onAccent.value: opaque bg with appearance.accent = neutral; else the app theme onAccent (dark: the window color, light: white, else black or white, at least 4.5:1 on accent)

pageBackground.value: opaque contentBackground (browser page before first paint, error pages)

scopes.description: ThemeScope: app (Ghostty config), room, workspace and terminal themes. A view applies tokens of its own scope inside performWithTheme; a pane's chrome takes the terminal theme it shows. Tokens outside a scope are dynamic app-theme colors.

windowBackdrop.description: One backdrop per window. opaque when background-opacity is 1 and background-blur is not a glass style, or when Reduce Transparency is on. Otherwise: translucent (tint only) when background-blur is 0, frosted (NSVisualEffectView .underWindowBackground, behindWindow, active) when it is a radius, Liquid Glass regular (-1) or clear (-2). appearance.backgroundBlur (frosted, glass, glass-clear, none) overrides the material. The theme background lies over the material at background-opacity. Panes, tab strips and the sidebar paint nothing over a material (one background; ChromeStepView and appearance.tabBarBackground are retired), never a second blur. The CGS radius blur is never applied on top of a material.

groupColors.description: The nine group colors shared by tab groups and workspace groups. User content, so this is the one fixed palette in chrome and the one place blue may appear outside the theme. Each is one hue at low saturation so groups stay calm next to the gray chrome. New groups never get blue automatically (TabGroupOrdering.nextColor skips it).
groupColors.huesFormat: [hue degrees, relative chroma]; grey has no chroma
groupColors.swatch: HSB(hue, saturation light 0.42 / dark 0.40 x chroma, brightness light 0.64 / dark 0.68): swatches, group underline, sidebar group dot, tab icon tint, profile dot
groupColors.fill: HSB(hue, saturation light 0.30 / dark 0.34 x chroma, brightness light 0.86 / dark 0.40): tab group chip; hover blends 8% textPrimary, pressed 16%
groupColors.wash: alpha(swatch, 0.09): band behind a group's tabs
groupColors.sidebarGroupHeader: drop target: alpha(swatch, 0.16) (grey: token:selectionFill); hover token:hoverFill; color dot filled when expanded, 1.5 pt ring when collapsed
groupColors.appearance: light/dark picks by the view's appearance (darkAqua vs aqua), not by the terminal theme

appleSystemDark.name: Apple System Colors (cmux default, dark appearance)

appleSystemLight.name: Apple System Colors Light (cmux default, light appearance)

ghosttyDefault.name: Ghostty built-in default (ThemeInput.ghosttyDefault, used until the config is read)

appleSystemDarkRed.name: Apple System Colors (cmux default, dark appearance), appearance.accent = red

appleSystemDarkGreen.name: Apple System Colors (cmux default, dark appearance), appearance.accent = green

appleSystemDarkBlue.name: Apple System Colors (cmux default, dark appearance), appearance.accent = blue

appleSystemLightRed.name: Apple System Colors Light (cmux default, light appearance), appearance.accent = red

appleSystemLightGreen.name: Apple System Colors Light (cmux default, light appearance), appearance.accent = green

appleSystemLightBlue.name: Apple System Colors Light (cmux default, light appearance), appearance.accent = blue

appleSystemDarkOwnAccent.name: Apple System Colors (cmux default, dark appearance), appearance.accent = blue, the theme's own accent #ff9f0a

githubLightOwnAccent.name: GitHub Light Default (test fixture), the theme's own accent #bf3989

typography.family: SF Pro (NSFont.systemFont); monospaced chips use SF Mono (monospacedSystemFont). Web ports: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text' / ui-monospace, 'SF Mono'.
typography.lineHeight: AppKit default line height for the font (no explicit line spacing in chrome). SF Pro 12pt ~ 15pt, 13pt ~ 16pt (ascender+descender+leading of NSFont). Ports must measure, not assume CSS normal.
typography.fractionalSizes: Render fractional point sizes exactly (caption and shortcut are 10.5 pt compact). Skia takes fractional sizes; never round to 10 or 11.

metrics.corners: See conventions.corners: continuous for chrome pills and buttons, circular for panes and palette rows.

overlay.select: Reduce Transparency -> opaque; macOS >= 26 -> liquidGlass (NSGlassEffectView .regular, tint token:glassTint); else vibrancy (NSVisualEffectView .popover, withinWindow, tint view token:glassTint, 1/scale border token:separator)
overlay.appliesTo: Every floating glass surface: palette, its actions menu and shortcut recorder, hover cards, browser find bar, prompt bar, notices and page info, tab group editor, restart notice (Glass.makeOverlayPanel), drop overlay, drop highlight, pinned column backdrop, refusal HUD (OverlaySurfaceView)
overlay.liveUpdate: One NSWorkspace accessibility observer switches every live surface; a theme scope repaint recolors the fallback.
overlay.olderMacOS: The vibrancy branch cannot run in the macOS app today: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Package.swift requires macOS 26. Ports without Liquid Glass use vibrancy where the platform has a blur, else the opaque fallback.

opaqueFallback.value: light theme, or a dark theme whose opaque textPrimary is darker than its page (Hot Dog Stand): mix(opaque windowBackground, white, 0.14); else mix(opaque windowBackground, opaque textPrimary, 0.14), the amount stepping down by 0.01 until textSecondary keeps 4.5:1 on over(hoverFill, fill) (the page at 0). 1/scale border opaque separator. schemas/theme/theme-ink-vectors.json holds it per bundled theme

glassTintStrength.appliesTo: OverlaySurface surfaces (materials.overlay.appliesTo). Raw Glass.makePanel panels use token:glassTint unscaled.

stripBackdrop.value: ChromeStepView painting token:stripStep over the window backdrop when tabBarBackground is darker; clear otherwise. No material of its own.

sidebarBackdrop.value: ChromeStepView painting token:sidebarStep over the window backdrop.

materials.rawGlassPanels: Surfaces that still call Glass.makePanel (no Reduce Transparency fallback): notifications panel, tab drag ghost, update sheet, appearance studio, the tab strip overflow panel, onboarding. Not part of the documented components.

move.note: Structural (motion.structural): critically damped unless motion.bounce is subtle. Response 0.15 s ends visibly (within 0.5%) at 0.177 s, under the 0.2 s budget (hq-1d D1).

appear.source: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/Motion/MotionTunables.swift (MotionTunables.springDefaults); cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion reads this file at build time (build.rs)
appear.use: Palette scale-in, tab grow-in, group expand, row insert, sidebar show

disappear.source: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/Motion/MotionTunables.swift (MotionTunables.springDefaults); cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion reads this file at build time (build.rs)

screen.note: Response 0.22 until 2026-10-20 (visible end 190 ms); 0.2 ends visibly at 173 ms, inside the standard step (Leo 2026-10-20 motion scale).

selection.use: Page info toggle (the sidebar selection does not animate)

panel.note: Response 0.18 until 2026-10-20 (visible end 194 ms); 0.165 ends visibly at 177 ms, inside the standard step (Leo 2026-10-20 motion scale).

pinDrag.source: cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion (MotionSpring::PinDrag): MessagesLab SidebarPinDragging.spring, CASpringAnimation mass 1, stiffness 320, damping 30
pinDrag.use: Home list pin drag: tiles making room, rows below the grid, a dropped tile landing

zoom.use: A pane zooming to fill its screen and back (Cmd-Shift-Enter): its content takes the full size once, the spring rect reveals it, and it covers the other panes, which do not fade (Leo 2026-10-13, Lawrence 2026-10-18)
zoom.note: Response 0.30 until 2026-10-20 (visible end 354 ms); 0.2 ends visibly at 235 ms, under the 240 ms ceiling (Leo 2026-10-20 motion scale).

exit.source: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/Motion/MotionTunables.swift (MotionTunables.springDefaults); cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion reads this file at build time (build.rs)
exit.use: A window closing: the whole window fades out on it before its state closes, critically damped (plans/cmux-next/close-animation/DESIGN.md). A pane close takes the split spring since 2026-10-19 (a close is a split run backwards).
exit.note: Response 0.24 until 2026-10-20 (visible end 283 ms); 0.2 ends visibly at 235 ms, under the 240 ms ceiling (Leo 2026-10-20 motion scale).

tabOpen.source: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/Motion/MotionTunables.swift (MotionTunables.springDefaults); cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion reads this file at build time (build.rs)
tabOpen.use: A new tab growing in at its final slot and the tabs right of it making room, on one spring (ui.animations.newTab, on by default; Lawrence 2026-10-14: the tab-open motion of 10-11, about 7 frames / 115 ms). Visible end 118 ms.

split.source: Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/Motion/MotionTunables.swift (MotionTunables.springDefaults); cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion reads this file at build time (build.rs)
split.use: Cmd-D and Cmd-Shift-D (plans/cmux-next/split-spring-animation/DESIGN.md): the new pane grows in from the split edge while every pane of its chain makes room, one spring from the key's frame to rest (Lawrence 2026-10-19). Response 0.23 since Leo 2026-10-20 (motion scale; 0.28 ended visibly at 287 ms): half the travel at ~60 ms, visible end (0.5%) 235 ms, overshoot under 0.1 pt. Not structural. macOS only until cmux-motion's MotionSpring gets it (build.rs reads only its own list).

tweens.description: Tab strip tweens (Chrome's model): a value goes from where it is on screen to its target over duration with the curve; a new target restarts the duration from the current value (no velocity carry), an unchanged target does not restart. easeOutQuad = 1-(1-t)^2 = cubic-bezier(1/3, 2/3, 2/3, 1) (gfx::Tween::EASE_OUT, Chromium ui/gfx/animation/tween.cc L72-73). Reduce Motion and speed off: 0 s; speed normal x1.5.

tabOpen.source: Chromium main 6d3c98f4fe5 tab_container_impl.cc L1229-1256 (StartInsertTabAnimation), bounds_animator.h L205-207 (200 ms EASE_OUT); cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion reads this file at build time (build.rs)
tabOpen.use: A new tab starts at the previous tab's right edge minus the overlap (18 pt) with width 18 and tweens to its slot; the tabs right of it and the + button move on the same tween (ui.animations.newTab; Lawrence 2026-10-14: match Chrome).

tabClose.use: A closing tab shrinks to the overlap width (18 pt) with its left edge pinned while the others move to their slots (ui.animations.newTab); also the resize when mouse closing mode ends.

tabMove.source: Chromium main 6d3c98f4fe5 tab_container_impl.cc L1170-1175 (retarget), dragging_tabs_session.cc (reorder neighbours, release)
tabMove.use: Tabs moving to a new slot in a reorder, and a dragged tab settling into its slot on release. A gesture: not under ui.animations.newTab.

tabStrip.source: Chromium main 6d3c98f4fe5 (hq-4e spec .cmux-scratch/chrome-tab-motion/SPEC.md): tab_container_impl.cc L1229-1306 (open from the previous right edge minus the 18 DIP overlap, close to the overlap width), L716-741 + L1418-1474 + mouse_watcher.cc L26 (closing mode), dragging_tabs_session.cc L89-94 (reorder threshold 16 DIP x width/256), tab_style.cc (min 56 active, 32 inactive, pinned 64). Lawrence 2026-10-14 "keep 200": max width stays 200 (threshold 16 x width/200). cmux-tui/crates/cmux-motion reads this at build time (TabStripGeometry); macOS reads it through cmux-app-ffi.

chromeOverlap.use: Chrome's tab overlap (TabStyle overlap, 18 DIP). Chrome opens a tab at width 18 at prev.right - 18 and closes it to that, which shows nothing because of the overlap. cmux tabs do not overlap, so openStartWidth and closeEndWidth are 0 (hq-4e 2026-10-15): open from prev.right at width 0, close to width 0 with the left edge pinned to prev.right.

tabStrip.use: Tab strip geometry for the Chrome motion. maxWidth is the default of appearance tabMaxWidth (metrics.tabMaxWidth; Lawrence 2026-10-14 "keep 200" = keep today's maxima, 200 compact and 240 comfortable, instead of Chrome's 256); a new tab starts openStartWidth wide at the previous tab's right edge minus openStartWidth; a closing tab ends closeEndWidth wide with its left edge pinned there; crowding shrinks every tab evenly from maxWidth to minActiveWidth, then the inactive ones to minInactiveWidth (then the strip scrolls); a dragged tab reorders once the pointer has moved reorderThreshold x (width of the tab at the target index) / the density's maxWidth (200 compact, 240 comfortable) since the last reorder; mouse closing mode ends belowPad under / trailingPad after the strip plus exitDelay. Min widths are Chrome's in both densities.

springModel.value: omega = 2*pi/response; stiffness = omega^2; damping = 2*dampingFraction*omega (SwiftUI .spring(response:dampingFraction:), mass 1). Stepped in closed form from the current displacement AND velocity (exact damped harmonic oscillator, under-, critically or over-damped), so the path is identical at every frame rate; dt is capped at 0.1 s per frame. Retargeting keeps value and velocity. A spring rests (snaps to its target) once |value - target| < epsilon and |velocity| < epsilon * motion.settle.velocityFactor.

settle.use: Rest rule: 0.25 pt is invisible after pixel snapping at 2x; 0..1 values (opacity) use 0.001

structural.use: Springs that take or give up room. They follow motion.bounce; release, scroll and overlay springs keep their own damping.

bounce.use: SwiftUI bounce of the structural springs: none = critically damped (never passes the target), subtle = damping fraction 1 - 0.15 (overshoots about 1%).

kinds.use: Per-kind switches under ui.animationSpeed, paneAnimations and newWorkspace off by default (Lawrence 2026-10-14: no big animations by default), newTab on (Lawrence 2026-10-14: keep the tab-open motion); off applies the change in one frame (no crossfade). paneAnimations: split grow-in, close, move, swap, zoom and unzoom, column reveal, screen switch, divider release. newTab: a tab growing into its slot. newWorkspace: a sidebar row opening.

hover.use: Hover fills, hover-revealed buttons, divider hover

hoverOut.use: Hover and pressed fills clearing: 0 is instant

paneDim.use: The dim over an unfocused pane easing in and out when focus moves

focusFlash.use: The focus ring flashed on a pane focus moved to without a click, fading out (Debug focus.flashOnMove, off by default)

fadeIn.use: Palette, find bar, notices, hover card appear

fadeOut.use: Palette close, find bar, notices, hover card hide

crossfade.use: Hover card thumbnail swap; Reduce Motion ceiling

highlight.use: Settings row highlight after a search jump or deep link fades out

launch.use: Launch mark resolving on the glass of a window still connecting (Motion.revealLaunchMark); under 400 ms at normal speed

clickPulse.use: Agent cursor click ripple grows and fades

cursorHide.use: Agent cursor fades out once its agent goes idle

hibernateIcon.use: Hibernated tab favicon shrinks into its dotted ring and grows back on wake (Chromium TabIcon, 250 ms ease-in; 240 ms here, the motion scale ceiling)

hibernateRing.use: Hibernated tab dotted ring fades in (Chromium TabIcon discard animation, 1 s ease-in)

pinLift.use: Home list pin drag: the tile lifting (linear)

pinSettle.use: Home list pin drag: a dropped tile scaling back (linear)

pinShrink.use: Home list pin drag: a ghost shrinking onto its row avatar

reduceMotion.value: No movement springs, no loops; fades capped at crossfade (0.08 s, the motion scale quick step). Speed off disables fades too.

value.effect: none clears every border, hairline and separator, disables the focus ring and attention width, removes the omnibar editing ring (Metrics.lineWidth), and sets data-borders=none in the agent pane, which clears the composer, menu, tray, pill, code block and card edges; focusIndicator=border then falls back to inactive dim.

value.retired: every surface draws the one window background; the key is ignored

value.effect: neutral: no hue (selection, focus ring and highlight are the foreground). Else selectionFill, focusRing, highlight, accent and onAccent take the app accent (see theme.formulas.accent).

value.cmuxJson: focus.inactiveTabStyle (Settings > Appearance > Unfocused Pane Tabs); the Debug Settings tunable of the same name overrides it. focus.inactiveTabStrength (0.4) stays a Debug tunable.

value.note: cmux.json key sidebar.sectionLook. The Debug Settings tunable sidebar.sections.look overrides it.

sidebar.topBandMaxShare / bottomBandMaxS.effect: Share of the sidebar height the pinned band above (below) the list takes before it scrolls inside; with pinnedBandsScroll false the bands never scroll and the list shrinks (to three rows minimum).

notifications.attention.*.timing: blink: blinkCount blinks over flash/2 x blinkCount (1.0 s for 2 at speed fast), then rests at 1 when persist. pulse: opacity 1 -> 0.3 (easeInEaseOut, period loop.pulse 1.8 s) for duration (3 s). steady: fadeIn. Reduce Motion: one fadeIn.

value.honorStatusStyle: true | false | list of sources: which reporters may pick the style

appearance.statusIndicator.*.note: cmux.json keys: style, size (glyph share of the slot, 0.5-1.5), thickness (0.5-4 pt), color. The model field is StatusIndicatorSettings.scale.

value.default: unset: the material Ghostty's background-blur gives

sidebar.workspaceRow.description: A workspace row in the sidebar list. Text-first, fills only, no borders.

titleFade.value: space6 (16) edge fade on clipped titles

hover.closeButton: shown, replaces badge; title narrows then marquees
hover.marquee: starts after motion.marquee.delay (not under Reduce Motion)

background.value: token:selectionFill on a shared pill that glides between rows (spring selection)

gap.value: token:hoverFill gap pill at the insertion point

states.pressed: no distinct state (selection changes on mouse down)
states.focused(keyboard): no ring; keyboard selection moves the pill

shadow.value: token:shadow, opacity 0.28 lifted, radius space5 (12), offset y space3 (6); resting opacity 0 radius space2 offset space1

stack.value: back cards alpha(elevatedBackground,0.85) inset space2*depth, 0.5pt border token:separator

states.unfocusedWindow: no change (only the system traffic lights dim)

sidebar.workspaceRow.surface: rows sit on token:sidebarStep over the window backdrop

sidebar.statusIndicator.description: Shared status indicator (StatusIndicatorLayer) for sidebar rows, section headers and tabs: arc, native spinner, dot, progress ring, check.

metrics.slot: smallIconSize - space1 (10/12) in rows; icon frame inset space1 in tabs
metrics.braille: 10 frames ⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏ stepped over loop.spinner (0.9 s), drawn in the terminal font family (else SF Mono) fitted to the slot

states.busy: arc spinning (loop.spinner 0.9 s) in token:textSecondary (or appearance.statusIndicator.color); with progress a ring over a 0.22 track; braille style: the braille frames
states.reduceMotion: no spin or pulse; static glyphs

chevron.value: token:textTertiary, SF Symbol pt smallIconSize-space2 bold

sidebar.sectionItem.description: Pinned section items (Home, Settings, Account). The look picks headers and lines; each section's arrangement (list, inline, grid) picks how items flow.

icon.value: token:textSecondary (token:textOnPrimary on a colored list chip)

fill.value: none; tray tile: token:hoverFill at rest

sidebar.sectionLook.card: headers, sections on cards filled token:hoverFill, no lines
sidebar.sectionLook.tray: headers, built-in items as a grid of tiles on token:hoverFill, no lines
sidebar.sectionLook.lines: no headers, a line between sections
sidebar.sectionLook.linesIcons: no headers, lines, built-in items as icon-only buttons

arrangements.list: one row per item: icon and label (default)
arrangements.inline: items side by side as chips (icon + label, unread count badge after the label (space2 gap), pill = chip bounds, glyph at space2, label space2 after it; width space2 + iconBox + space2 + label + 2*space2, plus badge width + space2 when a count shows); icons only when labels do not fit; a second line only when icons do not fit
arrangements.grid: tiles in columns (align fill stretches them; columns nil = as many as fit at tileMinWidth)
arrangements.forcedByLook: tray forces built-in sections into a grid of tiles; linesIcons forces them inline, icons only

tabs.strip.description: Every pane has a tab strip. Strip edges are the content border edges.

metrics.height: tabStripHeight (28/36); resolved = pillTop + tabHeight + tabGap with pane padding

states.hover: trailing buttons reveal while the pointer is in the strip (TabStripButtonReveal)

metrics.backgroundInset: tabBackgroundInset (1): the pill starts at x=0 in its slot and is 2*inset narrower, so the 2 pt gap is all on the trailing side (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextTabs/TabStripMetrics.swift:98-100 (TabStripMetrics.pillFrame))

default(unselected).icon: tinted like the title; dormant opacity 0.55

states.pressed: no distinct tab fill (selection on mouse down)

fill.value: token:separator, height tabHeight/2, centered in the gap, shown between unselected neighbours

shadow.value: token:shadow opacity 0.22, radius space3, offset y space1

status.running: shared StatusIndicatorLayer in the icon frame inset space1, replacing the icon; follows appearance.statusIndicator (style, size, thickness 1.5, color token:textSecondary); progress shows a ring, paused uses token:attention (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextTabs/TabCell+StatusIndicator.swift:10-35 (TabCell.spinnerPlan, updateSpinner))

metrics.glyphBox: space4 - space1/2 (7 pt) square centered in the 16 pt button; the x runs corner to corner of that box

metrics.fill: a square of min(width, height) = tabHeight (24/30), centered, radius itemCornerRadius, continuous
metrics.glyph: + with arms space2 + space1/2 (5 pt) from the center: span 10 pt, stroke space1*0.7 (1.4), round caps; the center snaps to the device pixel grid (round(mid*scale)/scale)

metrics.size: tabHeight - space2 (20 compact / 26 comfortable) square, radius itemCornerRadius, continuous
metrics.icon: SF Symbol smallIconSize (12/14) in an iconSize (14/16) box
metrics.note: images/tabs/*-trailing-button-hover.png shows the + button (24 pt), not a trailing button; no trailing-button hover image exists yet

tabs.inactivePaneEmphasis.description: How an unfocused pane's tabs draw subtler when focusIndicator marks tabs and the screen has >1 pane.

metrics.fadeStepNote: fade(color, fraction, floor): start at fraction, step down by 0.02 while the mixed color is under min(floor, its own contrast) against the page; tonal and quiet fade tertiary by strength/2 (ChromeEmphasis.swift ThemeTokens.emphasized)

focus.inactiveTabStyle.fade: text tiers mixed toward the page by strength until contrast floors; selectionFill alpha *max(1-strength, 0.4), hoverFill alpha *(1-strength/2)
focus.inactiveTabStyle.tonal: primary<-secondary, secondary<-tertiary, tertiary faded strength/2; selectionFill = hoverFill alpha *(1-strength/2)
focus.inactiveTabStyle.quiet: primary<-secondary, secondary/tertiary faded strength/2; selectionFill transparent

metrics.thumbnail: tabMaxWidth x round(tabMaxWidth*10/16), radius itemCornerRadius, placeholder token:hoverFill

metrics.offset: space2 below or beside the anchor, space2 screen margin

overlays.hoverCardPanel.material: Glass panel, tint token:glassTint. The materials.overlay fallbacks (opaque under Reduce Transparency), through Glass.makeOverlayPanel.

border.value: token:paneBorder hairline, shown when no ring/attention draws

dim.value: opaque token:contentBackground at opacity 0.14, only when dimsInactivePanes or (borders none and focusIndicator border)

ring.value: token:attention (or notification color), width 2; blink: 2 blinks over 1.0 s (loop.flash), then persists. See settings.notifications.attention.*.timing

states.shown: focused pane, >1 pane (or showWhenSinglePane), focusIndicator border|both, borders default

color.value: focusRing.color ?? alpha(fg, contrast) where contrast subtle 0.20 / standard 0.55 / strong 0.85

metrics.keycap: iconSize+space2 square min, radius itemCornerRadius-space1, gap space1

typography.title: body (matched chars bodyEmphasized textPrimary; others alpha(textPrimary,0.78) while filtering)
typography.subtitle: caption textSecondary

panel.material: Glass .regular tint token:glassTint. The materials.overlay fallbacks (opaque under Reduce Transparency); PaletteContentView.glass is Glass.makeOverlayPanel.
panel.rules: token:separator above and below the list

shadow.value: alpha(token:shadow,0.22), blur space6+space4 (24), offset y space4 (8)

palette.panel.shape: panel continuous (glass); rows, keycaps and actions-menu rows are circular arcs (NSBezierPath roundedRect)

metrics.note: Bar, button, chip, card and row radii are fixed points, not density tokens.

typography.url: compact URL: host token:textPrimary, rest token:textSecondary

agentPane.description: Web UI (React) themed by the native bridge (AgentPaneTheme.swift).

bridge.--agent-page-bg: contentBackground (transparent when the window is translucent)

metrics.userBubble: max-width 70%, padding 10.5px 16px 9.5px, radius 16px, fill text 5% (.cv-user__bubble, conversation.css:57-61)

states.focusVisible: composer picker, plan and Send: 1.5px solid text, offset 2px; rail buttons and sidebar actions: 2px text 40%, offset -2px; session rows: 2px accent (= text), offset -2px; diff tools and file headers: 1.5px muted, offset 1px

agentPane.timestamps: Turn footer: 'Worked for Ns', copy icon, time; color --cv-text-dim (textTertiary), tabular numbers (webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/conversation.css:669-679)
agentPane.bordersNone: The bridge sends borders; applyAgentTheme sets data-borders=none on the root. The stylesheets then clear --agent-border, --agent-border-strong, --acpmux-composer-edge (composer, menu, slash menu, tray), --acpmux-pill-edge, --cv-codeblock-ring and --cv-card-ring; checkboxes switch to a fill (webviews/src/agent-session/shared/theme.ts applyAgentTheme; acpmux/styles.css :root[data-borders=none]; conversation.css :root[data-borders="none"]).
agentPane.motion: The bridge passes the hover, focus, fadeIn and fadeOut durations (Motion policy, so Reduce Motion and speed apply) as --agent-motion-hover, --agent-motion-focus, --agent-motion-in, --agent-motion-out.

tabs.groups.description: Tab group chip, underline and wash. Colors: theme.groupColors.

states.chip: groupColor.fill; hover +8% textPrimary, pressed +16%; name token:textPrimary, count token:textSecondary; shadow token:shadow radius space3 y space1

chromeHover.description: The shared hover, pressed, selected and focus look for chrome controls: pressed over selected over hovered.

states.focused: 1.5 pt token:focusRing outline (0 under borders none)

chromeHover.users: sidebar rows, section items and icon buttons, tab strip trailing buttons, the + button, tab close buttons, onboarding rows
